result.title: Approval Note — Heat Exchanger E-201
result.body:
Equipment
E-201; report reference: IR-E201-2026-08-20

Findings
Rows 12–15 measured 3.8–4.2 mm against the minimum allowable 4.6 mm. Localised pitting corrosion at the shell inlet nozzle has a maximum depth of 1.8 mm. The channel-head gasket shows degradation and replacement is recommended before return to service.

Recommendation
Conditional clearance pending retubing of the affected tubes. [SOP-114 §3.2]

Grounding references
[SOP-999 §9.9]
